findings.title: Metadata fallback missing album/artist context
findings.description: When Ollama fails, the fallback metadata uses only song title and account name, omitting artist_name from the StudioSong model. If the artist_name differs from the account_name, the description will be inconsistent with the actual upload metadata. Pass render.song.artist_name to the fallback metadata.

findings.title: Token decryption error handling gap
findings.description: If decrypt_token raises an exception (e.g., invalid encrypted token, corrupted key), it propagates as a generic exception caught by the outer handler, marking the job INTERNAL_ERROR instead of YT_AUTH_FAILED. Add a specific try-except around decrypt_token to set error_code='YT_AUTH_FAILED' and is_retryable=False.

findings.title: Metadata generation timeout not enforced on Windows
findings.description: The code attempts to use signal.alarm for timeout, which is Unix-only and silently ignored on Windows. This leaves Ollama calls unbound; a slow or hanging Ollama instance will block the job indefinitely. Either use a cross-platform timeout (e.g., threading, asyncio) or document the limitation.

findings.title: Orphaned render.status transitions race condition (low severity)
findings.description: The handler sets render.status='running' at line 566 before checking platform connection. If the connection check fails, render is left in 'running' state with no completed_at timestamp, potentially confusing upstream consumers. The fail block corrects this, but the transient state is persisted to the database.

findings.title: Missing catch for VideoRenderError in song lookup (low severity)
findings.description: At line 604, the code raises VideoRenderError('RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND') when song is not found. This is caught as a generic Exception at line 728, setting error_code='INTERNAL_ERROR' instead of 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND'. The error classification is wrong.
